description: Call this when the user is building, planning, or reviewing a Branch Disbursements integration, where the partner pays workers through Branch Wallet or Branch Direct. This includes Disbursements with Tax Filing, Co-Branded Card, or Whitelabel. Returns the standard step-by-step integration path: Create Employee, Branch-hosted onboarding, the webhook gate, V2 disbursements, and lifecycle handling, plus the patterns to avoid. Use it before writing or reviewing integration code. Not for Flex EWA, Paycard, or Stripe Connect, which follow different paths.
name: disbursements-integration
title: Disbursements Integration
